Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

sdidlab 0.1.0

  • First public release, extracted from a higher-education research pipeline and generalised to any long panel.
  • Estimation core verified against synthdid: SDID, SC and DiD estimates, weights and untrimmed placebo standard errors match exactly, with and without covariates.
  • Fixes found during verification: placebo inference for sc and did estimates; fit diagnostics and the trimming rule now use the covariate-adjusted outcome; project_out_covariates() works with arrays; synthetic-control weights are solved exactly (active-set) rather than stopping short of convergence; exact pre-period fits are flagged.
  • New: Abadie-L’Hour penalty in fit_scm(); sdid_panel(), register_outcome() and register_pool(); self-contained scripts from write_spec_script(); the interactive run_demo() app.

Developed by James Hodges.

Site built with pkgdown 2.2.1.
